brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished residential structures, facilities, and water wells in Hebron, according to Ma'an Wire. The operation destroyed multiple properties across the area, affecting civilian infrastructure and water access for residents.

The demolitions are part of a broader pattern of structure destruction in the occupied West Bank. Palestinian residents say such operations displace families, eliminate sources of livelihood, and force communities from their land. International humanitarian organizations have documented the practice as contributing to displacement and humanitarian hardship in Palestinian-controlled areas.
title: Israeli forces demolish homes and water wells in Hebron
